_comment: ECS Fargate Task Definition — Angular multi-stage build with Secrets Manager runtime config injection (cz-js-1014), SSM-injected nginx.conf (cz-css-1012), S3 asset sync sidecar (cz-css-1010), and CSS validation sidecar (cz-css-1006).
_description: Rule cz-js-1014: Angular applications without multi-stage Dockerfile include Node.js, npm,
Angular CLI, and source files in the final container image, bloating size by 10x.
Remediation: Multi-stage build (Node.js builder + nginx:alpine runtime) + ECS Fargate
Secrets Manager injection replaces hardcoded Angular environment files (environment.prod.ts)
with runtime-config.json written by the entrypoint script from Secrets Manager env vars.
This enables single-image promotion across dev / staging / production without rebuilding.
Required secrets (from AWS Secrets Manager):
/app/angular/api-base-url        → API_BASE_URL
/app/angular/feature-flags       → FEATURE_FLAGS
/app/angular/app-env             → APP_ENV
/app/angular/cognito-user-pool-id → COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID
/app/angular/cognito-client-id   → COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
Rule cz-css-1006: Development CSS files (styles.dev.css, debug.css, test styles) must NOT
be present in the production container image. A short-lived CSS validation sidecar container
(essential: false, dependsOn: COMPLETE) runs before the main application container starts.
It scans the application image for any dev/debug CSS files and exits with a non-zero code
if any are found, preventing the main container from starting with dev CSS artefacts.
The .dockerignore file also excludes *.dev.css, *.debug.css, debug.css, and test*.css
from the Docker build context as a first line of defence.
Rule cz-css-1010: Large inline base64 assets in CSS bloat container images and bypass CDN caching.
Remediation: A sidecar container (essential: false) syncs extracted static assets from the
application container to S3 at task start using the task IAM role. CloudFront then serves
the assets via CDN_BASE_URL, eliminating inline base64 data URIs from CSS.
The sidecar exits after the sync completes (essential: false ensures the main app continues).
Required ECS task IAM role permissions: s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket
on the ASSETS_S3_BUCKET. CDN_BASE_URL must be set to the CloudFront distribution domain.
Rule cz-css-1012: Multi-stage Dockerfile separates CSS preprocessor tools from the minimal
nginx:alpine runtime image. The nginx.conf is stored in AWS SSM Parameter Store and injected
into the ECS Fargate task at runtime via the `secrets` field below, enabling environment-specific
routing rules (dev / staging / prod) without rebuilding the container image.
SSM Parameter Store path: /app/nginx/nginx-conf
The entrypoint script writes the injected NGINX_CONF_CONTENT env var to /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
before NGINX starts. If the secret is absent the bundled template is used as a fallback.

secrets._comment: [cz-css-1012] nginx.conf content injected from SSM Parameter Store at task startup.
secrets._description: Stores the full nginx.conf as a SecureString in SSM Parameter Store under /app/nginx/nginx-conf. The ECS execution role must have ssm:GetParameters permission on this path. The entrypoint script writes NGINX_CONF_CONTENT to /etc/nginx/nginx.conf before NGINX starts, enabling environment-specific routing rules without rebuilding the image.
secrets.name: NGINX_CONF_CONTENT

secrets._comment: [cz-css-1008] Critical CSS content injected from SSM Parameter Store.
secrets.name: CRITICAL_CSS_CONTENT

secrets._description: Secrets Manager stores the environment-specific API base URL. The entrypoint writes this into runtime-config.json which Angular reads via APP_INITIALIZER, enabling single-image promotion without rebuilds.
secrets.name: API_BASE_URL

secrets._comment: [cz-js-1014] Angular feature flags injected from Secrets Manager — replaces hardcoded feature flag values in environment files.
secrets.name: FEATURE_FLAGS

secrets.name: APP_ENV

dependsOn._comment: [cz-css-1006] Main app waits for the CSS validation sidecar to complete successfully before starting.

containerDefinitions.name: css-validation-sidecar
containerDefinitions._comment: [cz-css-1006] Short-lived CSS validation sidecar: scans the application image for development/debug CSS files before the main container is allowed to start. Exits with code 1 if any dev CSS files are found, preventing the task from proceeding with bloated or debug-exposing artefacts. essential:false ensures the task is not permanently failed if the check is skipped in non-production environments.
_description: Rule cz-css-1006: Development CSS Files in Production Container.
This sidecar runs to COMPLETE before the main dashboard-app container starts (dependsOn COMPLETE).
It searches the shared /app/assets volume for any file matching dev/debug CSS patterns:
- *.dev.css  (e.g. styles.dev.css)
- *.debug.css
- debug.css
- test*.css
If any such file is found the sidecar exits with code 1, which causes the ECS task to
report a failure and prevents the main application container from starting.
In production this acts as a runtime gate complementing the .dockerignore build-time gate.
The FAIL_ON_DEV_CSS environment variable can be set to 'false' to downgrade the check
to a warning-only mode (exits 0) for non-production environments.
command: echo '[cz-css-1006] Starting CSS validation scan...'; DEV_CSS_FILES=$(find /usr/share/nginx/html -type f \( -name '*.dev.css' -o -name '*.debug.css' -o -name 'debug.css' -o -name 'test*.css' \) 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$DEV_CSS_FILES" ]; then echo '[cz-css-1006] ERROR: Development CSS files detected in production image:'; echo "$DEV_CSS_FILES"; if [ "${FAIL_ON_DEV_CSS}" != 'false' ]; then echo '[cz-css-1006] FAIL: Aborting task startup. Remove dev CSS files from the production image.'; exit 1; else echo '[cz-css-1006] WARN: Dev CSS files found but FAIL_ON_DEV_CSS=false — continuing in warning mode.'; fi; else echo '[cz-css-1006] PASS: No development CSS files found in production image.'; fi; echo '[cz-css-1006] CSS validation complete.'

environment._comment: [cz-css-1006] Set to 'false' in non-production environments to downgrade the dev CSS check to a warning instead of a hard failure.
environment.name: FAIL_ON_DEV_CSS

volumesFrom._comment: [cz-css-1006] Mount the main application container's filesystem read-only so the sidecar can inspect the deployed HTML/CSS assets.

containerDefinitions.name: asset-sync-sidecar
containerDefinitions._comment: [cz-css-1010] Sidecar container: syncs extracted static assets to S3 at task start.
